subject: Private Deployment: operator boundary & evidence request
messages:
From: Melissa Carter <melissa.carter@helixlabs.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: James Lee <j.lee@helixlabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private Deployment: operator boundary & evidence request

Rishi —

Thanks for the demo last week. We are moving toward an on-prem / VPC deployment for our inference workloads and need to align on a few contract items before procurement will sign the Order Form. High level asks from our legal and security teams: 

- Clarify operator access boundary: will Redwood staff have console/SSH access to VMs or only a recovery/admin channel?
- Evidence & audit pathway: can you provide a snapshot handover or escrow-style artifact (encrypted image + integrity attestation) in the event of provider exit?
- Audit windows: what is the typical lead time for an on-site or remote audit, and can you provide proof artifacts (KV snapshot manifests, operator activity logs) for a 90-day retention window?
- MSA redlines: we have a short list of edits to the license scope and indemnity exhibits; procurement needs a marked-up MSA.

Attaching our SOW draft for context. Can you confirm whether Redwood is willing to commit to a staged evidence delivery plan (what you might call an "escrow-lite" handoff) and a proposed timeline for legal review?

Best,
Melissa Carter
Head of Procurement, Helix Labs
[Attachment: Helix_SOW_Draft_v3.pdf (PDF)]

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Melissa Carter <melissa.carter@helixlabs.ai>

Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private Deployment: operator boundary & evidence request

Melissa —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can support a scoped, staged evidence handoff (we've been calling it "escrow-lite") and provide operator boundary language, but we need to align the exact artifacts and retention windows with our Legal and Infra teams. I've attached an initial set of redlines to the MSA (track changes) to surface our preferred language and alternative positions.

Proposed next steps: 
- Legal review: Laura to confirm acceptable escrow-lite language and any carveouts.
- Infra runbook: Jordan to list the deliverable artifacts (encrypted VM image, KV manifest, operator manifest, audit log extract) and the expected format.
- Timeline: we can produce a draft bundle + redlines within ~7 business days; evidence delivery procedure (technical runbook) in ~10 business days after that.

Would you be able to schedule a 30-min sync Thursday (Feb 5) to walk through the deliverables and procurement redlines?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_MSA_track_changes.docx (DOCX)]

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Private Deployment: operator boundary & evidence request (internal)

Folks —

I reviewed Melissa's note and Rishi's initial redlines. High level legal position and proposed language snippets below — please treat as internal and draft into the MSA redline doc.

1) Operator access boundary
- We should propose: Redwood personnel access limited to a "recovery-only" channel except for emergency maintenance with written request and audit trail. Add explicit prohibition on arbitrary remote shell access.

2) Escrow-lite / evidence handoff
- Offer staged artifacts: (a) encrypted VM snapshot + SHA256 manifest; (b) KV cache export with integrity hash; (c) operator account activity log for the prior 90 days.
- Include a clause that handover is triggered on termination for convenience after 30 days' notice, or earlier by written agreement.
- Avoid language that constitutes a transfer of IP. Provide a covenant of cooperation + delivery of artifacts only for the customer's licensed data and artifacts.

3) Audit windows and proof artifacts
- Commit to remote audit with 10 business days' notice. On-site audit accommodated with 30 business days' notice and a mutually agreeable scope.
- Provide sample manifest format in the evidence checklist (attached).

4) Retention and deletion
- Retain operator activity logs for 90 days; provide export procedure for longer retention per SOW.

I'm attaching an evidence checklist spreadsheet with the manifest columns and example integrity fields. Jordan/aditya: can you confirm the formats and whether we can produce the encrypted VM + manifest and KV exports in the proposed timeframe? If not, flag which items need adjustment.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Melissa Carter <melissa.carter@helixlabs.ai>, Procurement <procurement@helixlabs.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 17:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private Deployment: operator boundary & evidence request — proposed plan and next steps

Melissa / Team —

Thanks — per our internal review please find the consolidated plan below and links to the artifacts we discussed. Short summary: Redwood will provide an "escrow-lite" evidence bundle plus operator boundary commitments and a runbook for delivery.

Deliverables (drafts linked):
- MSA redlines (track changes): https://drive.redwood.com/teams/helix/privdeploy-evidence (see file redlines_MSA_track_changes.docx)
- Evidence spec (manifest + sample hashes): https://drive.redwood.com/teams/helix/privdeploy-evidence (see evidence-checklist.xlsx)
- Technical runbook: planned deliverable in 10 business days (will include steps for creating encrypted VM snapshots, KV export format, and verification steps).

Legal commitments (high level):
- Operator access: Redwood personnel access limited to defined recovery/admin channels; no arbitrary SSH/console except by mutual written agreement or emergency process with audit trail.
- Evidence handover triggers: termination for convenience (30-day notice) or earlier by signed agreement; artifacts provided do not transfer Redwood IP and are limited to customer-licensed data and configuration.
- Audit windows: remote audit with 10 business days' notice; on-site audit with 30 business days' notice.

Next steps we need from you:
1) Can Helix confirm acceptance of the proposed high-level commitments above? (quick thumbs up is fine to proceed to doc redline refinement)
2) Please confirm any additional artifact types you need in the bundle beyond the items in the evidence checklist.
3) If Thurs Feb 5 11:00 AM PT still works, we can keep the sync to walk through the manifest layout and the DocuSign path for the Order Form.

When you confirm, I'll route the updated redline package into DocuSign for the Order Form and share the runbook draft.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
